arChildNodes.szComment: The PLAYER watches as LORATH and TYRAEL work around the table bearing the CUBE’s pedestal, drawing new RUNES in chalk. Lorath lingers on an old, smudged mark.
The two finish their work. Tyrael touches his hands to the runes, but nothing happens. He pauses, perplexed.

Tyrael gratefully offers his palms up. Lorath uses a chalky finger to daub the final runes onto them. 

Tyrael tries again. This time, the circle pulses alive. The Cube hovers and unfolds into panels. Tendrils of magic spill up and out.
Lorath waves the Player closer. They lay the pieces of Mother’s Promise into the Cube. It closes.
Tyrael and Lorath begin to manipulate the tendrils of magic, in turn manipulating the Cube.
At last, they move in unison, and magic surges. The Cube stills, then opens. The dagger is whole.
Suddenly, the world distorts. The Player keels over, hands on their head, stumbling.

We get glimpses into our mindscape, contorted by Mephisto’s presence.

But we can’t hear him anymore. Our vision fades as we are forced away from Sanctuary, into a place within our own mind.

FADE TO BLACK
